{{Top|leg}}
An '''Trandoshan Grooming Kit''' was kit that contained a selection of lotions and tools, which were marketed at [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]]. During the [[Cularin Trade Show]], a trade show that was held in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[TAV Prosperity|TAV ''Prosperity'']], a Trandoshan Grooming Kit was available for purchase from a trade stand operated by the business [[Nenmo's Curios]].
